hero.title: Built for the UAE Driver.
hero.subtitle: Genuine and OEM auto parts, sourced globally and stocked locally in Dubai since 2015.

story.title: We started with one frustration: waiting weeks for a part that should take a day.
story.body1: ASIL was founded in Dubai in 2015 after our own team spent too many afternoons chasing down a single brake caliper that sat in a customs warehouse for three weeks. We built the company we wished existed — one that actually stocks the parts UAE drivers need, in the UAE, ready to move.
story.body2: Today that means over 10,000 SKUs held locally across engine, brake, filtration and electrical systems, sourced directly from certified manufacturers and matched precisely to what's on the road here — from daily runabouts to full workshop rebuilds.

values.title: The principles behind every order.
values.item1Body: Every part is traced to a certified manufacturer or authorized channel before it's allowed into our catalogue — no grey-market substitutes.
values.item2Body: Our team confirms compatibility against your VIN or vehicle details before you order, so the part that arrives is the part that fits.
values.item3Body: We hold inventory locally in Dubai rather than drop-shipping from overseas — that's what makes same-day dispatch possible.
values.item4Body: One WhatsApp thread from question to delivery — no ticket numbers, no call centres, no chasing.

timeline.title: Nine years of stocking the right part.
timeline.y1_body: Opened our first parts counter in Al Quoz with a catalogue of under 500 SKUs.
timeline.y2_body: Moved into our current Al Quoz Industrial Area warehouse to hold serious inventory locally.
timeline.y3_body: Crossed 10,000 stocked parts across engine, brakes, filtration and electrical systems.
timeline.y4_body: Same-day dispatch in Dubai, next-day across every other Emirate.

how.title: Four steps to a dealer account
